# reactivity-store (RStore)

> AI-friendly index of the RStore documentation site.
> RStore is a React state management library powered by Vue's reactivity system (@vue/reactivity).
> Direct state mutation → automatic UI updates; middleware for persistence/DevTools; TypeScript-first.

- [Why RStore?](/why)
